# yunjian-miniapp-fixture

Synthetic fixtures used to exercise the mini-app (wxapkg) scanning channel of
the Yunjian cloud-credential leak detection platform.

**Every value in this repository is randomly generated by a script and belongs to
no real account.** This repository exists so the platform's public-URL
collection path (source_mode=url) can be tested against a resource that is
genuinely, verifiably public.

Contents:

- `public_fixture.wxapkg` - a plaintext wxapkg package containing JavaScript
  with synthetic credential-shaped values in several layouts.
- `config.js` - the same values in a loose config file.

These are detection *fixtures*, not leaked credentials.
